name_ko: 보호 · 다중 실드 파동 · 음원 후보

metrics.analysis_note: 5ms max-channel RMS; dominant-rise and separated maxima are signal hypotheses, not semantic impact counts or perceived strength

normalization: none; gain is in pairing routes

sources.envelope: 33-point sin-in / cos-out, linearly interpolated; gain excluded
sources.origin: Grok-generated audio or recorded studio mix thereof; not a claimed live recording

concept_basis: label-derived descriptors plus reviewed contexts; not acoustic classification

prompt_records.prompt: Six-second photorealistic single continuous shot with the physical source visibly active. Capture clear realistic close audio synchronized to motion. One event, no forced three takes; preserve onset, body and natural decay. No background music, singing, speech, narration, chiptune, 8-bit, synthetic effects, cartoon sounds, edits or captions. Avoid unnecessary mechanical hum and digital clipping. A felt mallet strikes a suspended large circular metal sheet once. Capture the real physical contact and a broad controlled metallic resonance which blooms and fades over approximately 1.250 seconds, avoiding musical melody, an explosion, synthetic effects and sustained machinery.
prompt_records.evidence: generation prompt recorded with crop SHA

alternate_use: Use as a layer with the reviewed route gain and start anchor.
For a new target, re-anchor the main onset and audition material/scale; matching peak dBFS alone is insufficient.
avoid_when: A crop carrying several audible events must not be repeated once per hit.
Source-specific rejected contexts are not automatically reusable.

intensity_profile.note: Generation order does not determine intensity. These are reviewed usage levels and separate signal measurements, not a universal perceptual ranking.

prompt_factors.source: descriptors from reviewed uses; actual prompt text only in prompt_records when traced
